script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: Calling Job humble presents an inference as a stated fact; verse 1 does not describe him that way.
The passage does not say that Job is not running any schemes.
The cookie-box comparison refers to Job’s servants alongside his animals as 'stuff.'
The text calls Job the greatest man of the East; it does not say nobody outranked him.
The text does not say nobody asked Job to rise early.
'He covers them in advance' suggests an effect of the offerings that the text does not state.
'This is his idea' asserts more than the text gives about the origin of Job’s practice.
Satan predicts that Job will curse God; he does not say Job will not praise Him.
The messenger does not say the raid came with no warning.
The next messenger arrives while the first is speaking, but the text does not say the first never gets to finish or that Job has no time to take it in.
The quoted portion is not the whole report; the messenger also says he alone escaped to tell Job.
'Goats aren't in this story' is broader than this passage; mountain goats appear later in Job 39:1.
'Job doesn't leave anywhere' makes a broad claim beyond what this passage says.
'He has just lost everything' goes beyond the reports; for example, the messengers have survived.
Saying Job has lost 'his servants' suggests they all died, although the messengers escaped.
